changelog:
ai-content-creator-assistant 1.1.0

- Rebuilt following BUILD_STANDARD: now inlines SM4 encryption and file_utils dependencies.
- Clarified compliance boundaries: no cookie use, auto-posting, or scraping of private/non-public data.
- Explicitly defines AI-delivered, payment-verified service workflow via clawtip.
- Outlines local-only order file storage for payment (no content or credential storage).
summary: Multi-platform content creation: generates 3-5 platform-adapted versions for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, WeChat, and more. AI-delivered service via clawtip payment verification. No cookies, no auto-posting, no scraping of private data. Reference link analysis limited to publicly visible content.
